trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 155-degree obtuse angle at the central convergence of the trailing edge; shallow vertical incision depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Linear boundary shows low-amplitude pixel fluctuations with a notable high-intensity irregular mass at the left distal tip representing localized calcified growths.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a broad convex sweep from the medial notch to the distal lobe tips, partially submerged at the right extremity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Contiguous high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the left lobe tip; additional sparse distribution of discrete white circular spots across the visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized accumulation of high-contrast, raised bio-growths on the left distal tip; widespread punctate scarring across the dark-pigmented surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'salt-and-pepper' mottling characterized by small-scale, high-intensity pixel clusters against a low-intensity field.
